answer.reason: The verses tell two chief deeds of Joseph of Arimathaea: asking Pilate for the body of Jesus and burying it in his own tomb.

clauses.english: begged Pilate for the body of Jesus and was given it
clauses.quote: went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.

clauses.english: wrapped the body of Jesus in linen and laid it in his own new tomb
clauses.quote: laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock
